# Everest Home

> Everest Home is a custom furniture manufacturing and interior design company serving all of Lebanon.
> The workshop is based in South Lebanon, and the company designs and builds made-to-order furniture,
> wooden decorations, professional painting and finishing, and complete turnkey interior projects
> across every Lebanese region — from idea to installation.

## Services

1. Furniture Manufacturing — living rooms, sectional sofas, bedrooms (master & kids), dining and
   coffee tables, storage units and built-in wardrobes, fully custom furniture made to measure,
   re-upholstery and renewal of old pieces.
2. Wood Decor — 3D wooden wall panels, built-in TV walls and media units, modern curved designs,
   luxury CNC wood details and slats, decorative ceilings and beams, custom wooden doors and partitions.
3. Painting & Finishing — professional furniture painting (PU & lacquer), matte and gloss multi-color
   finishes, natural wood grain enhancement, restoration and repainting of old furniture.
4. Interior Design — on-site consultations, space planning, furniture/lighting/accessories selection,
   color and material harmony, 3D visualization before execution, turnkey project management.
5. Bedrooms — complete bedrooms: headboard beds, built-in wardrobes, nightstands, dressers,
   kids' bedrooms, hidden lighting.
6. Sofas & Living Rooms — L/U-shaped sectionals, reception salons, sofa beds, velvet/linen/leather
   fabrics, matching coffee tables.
7. Tables — dining tables (4-12 people), coffee tables, side tables, marble/ceramic/wood tops.
8. Wardrobes & Storage — walk-in closets, floor-to-ceiling built-ins, TV storage units,
   small-space solutions.
9. TV Walls & Media Units — integrated TV walls, 3D panels, hidden LED, cable concealment,
   soundbar and fireplace integration.
10. Re-upholstery — sofa/chair re-upholstery, foam and spring repair, stain-resistant fabrics,
    full salon renewal, headboard upholstery.
11. Dining Rooms & Buffets — dining tables (6-14 people), upholstered chairs, vitrines and
    buffets with glass and lighting (nich/buffet).
12. Home Office Furniture — custom desks, libraries, file storage, cable concealment,
    office and company furniture.
13. Entrance & Console Tables — entrance consoles, decor mirrors, reception and key storage,
    hidden lighting, brass and gold details.
14. Custom Kitchens — floor-to-ceiling cabinets, islands, marble/quartz countertops,
    pull-out storage, under-cabinet lighting, moisture-resistant finishes.
15. Pergola & Outdoor Furniture — wooden pergolas, outdoor lounges and tables,
    treated wood, weatherproof finishes, maintenance and renewal.
16. Bathroom Vanities — floating sink units, moisture-resistant cabinets, LED mirrors,
    marble/quartz tops, hotel spa-style designs.
17. Commercial Decor — restaurants, cafes, shops and offices: fronts, counters, seating,
    reception decor, commitment to opening deadlines.
18. Mashrabiya & Oriental Woodwork — CNC arabesque carving, mashrabiya partitions,
    brass and mother-of-pearl inlay, oriental wall panels.
19. Wooden Doors — luxury main doors, room doors, sliding and hidden doors,
    wooden partitions, sound insulation.

## Occasions & Styles

Full bridal home furnishing packages (bedroom + salon + dining + buffet). Office and company
furnishing. All styles: modern, classic, neo-classic, minimal, rustic. Solutions for every
budget — material choices adapt the cost without compromising quality.

## Materials Expertise

Woods: beech (structures, chairs, tables, beds), oak (luxury grain pieces), high-grade MDF
(painted surfaces, CNC, wardrobes), natural veneer (premium fronts and doors).
Fabrics: velvet, linen, bouclé (2026 trend), leather, stain-resistant family fabrics.
Common questions answered on the site: beech vs MDF, best sofa fabric, custom vs ready-made
furniture, reupholstery timelines, natural veneer work.

## Areas Served

All of Lebanon — every governorate: South Lebanon (Tyre, Nabatieh, Sidon, Bint Jbeil,
Marjayoun, Hasbaya), Beirut, Mount Lebanon (Jounieh, Metn, Keserwan, Chouf), North Lebanon
(Tripoli, Akkar), Bekaa (Zahle), and Baalbek-Hermel. The workshop is based in South Lebanon
and projects are delivered across the whole country.

## Why Everest Home

- 100% local manufacturing with high quality standards
- Fully custom designs tailored to each space and client
- 10+ years of combined craftsmanship experience, 500+ completed projects
- Specialized team for carpentry, upholstery, painting, and design
- Careful selection of sustainable, high-quality materials
- Competitive prices with no middlemen, on-time delivery
- Free first consultation; detailed free quotes

## Process

1. Consultation — listening to the client's idea and needs (free).
2. Design — turning the idea into a clear vision, including 3D visualization.
3. Build & Install — manufacturing with premium materials and professional installation.
4. Delivery & Follow-up — final quality check and after-delivery support.
